attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (Erlang 26), created the `payments` vhost with an application user `payments_app` holding full permissions, and declared a durable quorum queue `orders` replicated across all three nodes. Demonstrated HA by stopping node1 (queue leader), confirming quorum queue failover to node2 with all messages preserved and consumable, publishing while node1 was down, then restarting node1 and confirming resync. Finally ran the mandatory node-restart protocol: rebooted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time via `systemctl reboot`, verified changed boot_id on each, confirmed RabbitMQ auto-started (enabled service), rejoined the cluster, and the quorum queue recovered full membership after each restart. End-to-end verification: published a message from node1 after all restarts and successfully consumed it from node3, proving cross-node data consistency post-restart.
